```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
print(df_original)
```
```{r}
df_original <- df_original %>%
  select(PitchofPA, PitcherThrows, BatterSide, Outs, Balls, Strikes, TaggedPitchType, PlayResult, RelSpeed, SpinRate, InducedVertBreak, HorzBreak, PlateLocHeight, PlateLocSide, ExitSpeed, Angle, Distance)
```

```{r}
df_original
```
```{r}
#df_baseball <- df_baseball %>%
  #mutate(keep = !is.na(ExitSpeed) | (dplyr::lead(!is.na(ExitSpeed)) & PitchofPA != 1)) %>%
  #filter(keep) %>%
  #select(-keep)
df_baseball <- df_original %>%
  filter(!is.na(ExitSpeed))

df_baseball <- df_baseball %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(PitchofPA, Outs, Balls, Strikes,
      RelSpeed, SpinRate, InducedVertBreak,
      HorzBreak, PlateLocHeight, PlateLocSide,
      ExitSpeed, Angle, Distance),
    as.numeric
  ))
df_baseball
```

```{r}
avg_exit <- df_baseball %>%
  summarise(avg_exit_speed = mean(ExitSpeed, na.rm = TRUE))

print(avg_exit)
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(df_baseball, aes(x = ExitSpeed)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  labs(title = "Exit Speed Distribution",
       x = "Exit Speed",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

MLB classifies a hart hit ball at 95 mph, for this project I will classify it as 90 mph. This is because I am analyzing Division 3 athletes, who on average are not as physically gifted as the average MLB player. 
```{r}
df_baseball <- df_baseball %>%
  mutate(
    ExitSpeedCategory = case_when(
      ExitSpeed > 90 ~ "Hard Hit",
      ExitSpeed >= 70 & ExitSpeed <= 90 ~ "Medium Hit",
      ExitSpeed < 70 ~ "Soft Hit",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

df_baseball <- df_baseball %>%
  mutate(
    ExitSpeedCategory = factor(
      ExitSpeedCategory,
      levels = c("Soft Hit", "Medium Hit", "Hard Hit"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```


```{r}
ggplot(df_baseball, aes(x = ExitSpeedCategory)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Contact Quality",
       x = "Contact Category",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
hard_hit_by_pitch <- df_baseball %>%
  filter(ExitSpeedCategory == "Hard Hit") %>%
  group_by(TaggedPitchType) %>%
  summarise(HardHitCount = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(HardHitCount))

print(hard_hit_by_pitch)
```

```{r}
hard_hit_rate <- df_baseball %>%
  group_by(TaggedPitchType) %>%
  summarise(
    TotalPitches = n(),
    HardHits = sum(ExitSpeedCategory == "Hard Hit", na.rm = TRUE),
    HardHitRate = HardHits / TotalPitches
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(HardHitRate))

print(hard_hit_rate)
```
```{r}
ggplot(hard_hit_rate,
       aes(x = reorder(TaggedPitchType, HardHitRate),
           y = HardHitRate)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Hard Hit Rate by Pitch Type",
       x = "Pitch Type",
       y = "Hard Hit Rate") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
df_baseball <- df_baseball %>%
  mutate(Count = paste(Balls, Strikes, sep = "-"))
hard_hit_count <- df_baseball %>%
  group_by(Count) %>%
  summarise(
    TotalPitches = n(),
    HardHits = sum(ExitSpeedCategory == "Hard Hit", na.rm = TRUE),
    HardHitRate = HardHits / TotalPitches
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(HardHitRate))

print(hard_hit_count)
```
```{r}
ggplot(hard_hit_count,
       aes(x = reorder(Count, HardHitRate),
           y = HardHitRate)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Hard Hit Rate by Count",
       x = "Count",
       y = "Hard Hit Rate") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
ggplot(df_baseball,
       aes(x = PlateLocSide,
           y = PlateLocHeight,
           color = ExitSpeedCategory)) +

  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +

  geom_rect(aes(xmin = -0.7,
                xmax = 0.7,
                ymin = 1.7,
                ymax = 3.5),
            fill = NA,
            color = "black",
            linewidth = 1) +

  labs(title = "Pitch Location vs Contact Quality",
       x = "Horizontal Location",
       y = "Vertical Location") +

  theme_minimal()+coord_fixed()
```

```{r}
ggplot(filter(df_baseball,
              ExitSpeedCategory == "Hard Hit"),
       aes(x = PlateLocSide,
           y = PlateLocHeight)) +

  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "red") +

  geom_rect(aes(xmin = -0.83,
                xmax = 0.83,
                ymin = 1.5,
                ymax = 3.5),
            fill = NA,
            color = "black",
            linewidth = 1) +

  labs(title = "Locations of Hard Hit Balls",
       x = "Horizontal Location",
       y = "Vertical Location") +

  theme_minimal()+coord_fixed()
```

```{r}
ggplot(filter(df_baseball,
              ExitSpeedCategory == "Hard Hit"),
       aes(x = PlateLocSide,
           y = PlateLocHeight)) +

  stat_density_2d(aes(fill = after_stat(level)),
                  geom = "polygon",
                  alpha = 0.6) +

  geom_rect(aes(xmin = -0.83,
                xmax = 0.83,
                ymin = 1.5,
                ymax = 3.5),
            fill = NA,
            color = "black",
            linewidth = 1) +

  labs(title = "Density of Hard Hit Ball Locations",
       x = "Horizontal Location",
       y = "Vertical Location") +

  theme_minimal() +
  coord_fixed()
```

```{r}
exit_model <- lm(
  ExitSpeed ~ PlateLocSide + PlateLocHeight,
  data = df_baseball
)

summary(exit_model)
```
```{r}
movement_model <- lm(
  ExitSpeed ~  SpinRate +
             InducedVertBreak +
             HorzBreak,
   data = df_baseball
)

summary(movement_model)
```

```{r}
full_model <- lm(
  ExitSpeed ~ PlateLocSide +
             PlateLocHeight +
             RelSpeed +
             SpinRate +
             InducedVertBreak +
             HorzBreak +
             Balls +
             Strikes +
             TaggedPitchType,
  data = df_baseball
)

summary(full_model)
```
